name: sg-llm-bundle-list
description: Visual bundle browser. Renders saved bundle index in reverse chronological order. Click to load (time travel). Delete action. Active bundle highlighted. Reads from sg-llm-bundle sibling.
notes: Uses Shadow DOM. Reads bundle index from sibling sg-llm-bundle.getIndex() on BUNDLE_LIST_CHANGED. Emits BUNDLE_LOAD_REQUESTED, BUNDLE_SAVE_REQUESTED, llm:bundle-delete-requested.
